*OEM: ''[[Arcadyan]]'' ([https://electric.garden/arcadyan-rax RAX]) • FCC ID: XJGDS0005 redirects to XJGDS0003 :VBR334 model is the same as the VBR333 but includes an HDMI cable.
According to Permissive Change documentation on the FCC, the main decode IC :changed from the BCM7630B in the [[Insignia NS-WBRDVD2]] to a BCM7633A :and additional DDR RAM was added to support the 3D feature.
It contains a daughterboard holding the Wi-Fi components including :two onboard antennas. Not a standard USB connector.
'''VIZIO VBR333''' - 3D Blu-ray Disc Player with ''Netflix/Pandora'' streaming :and built-in 2x2 MIMO single band Wi-Fi.
